title: Good: forbid(unsafe_code) enforced at crate level
description:
Location: rust/lichen-link/src/lib.rs line 45

The crate-level `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` attribute ensures no unsafe blocks can be added to this crate. All memory safety is delegated to dependencies (schnorr48, sha2, etc.) which are audited separately.

This is the correct approach for a security-critical protocol implementation.
